mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate over the past 3 months, indicating a rapidly tightening labor market, will lead to wage inflation and reduced corporate profitability, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops >0.5pp in 3mo but SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth slows by more than 2pp year-over-year, it signals a supply-driven slowdown that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by rising unemployment.
failure_condition: Y/Y INDPRO growth slows by >2pp and UNRATE is rising, but SPX 60-day returns are positive in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, especially in a high-inflation environment.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL > 250, but SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales, indicating a weakening consumer sector, will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, especially if accompanied by a rising unemployment rate.
failure_condition: RSAFS declines >5% Y/Y and UNRATE is rising, but SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Steadily rising payroll employment, indicating a strong labor market, will support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, especially in the early stages of an economic expansion.
failure_condition: PAYEMS rising at a >2% Y/Y clip but SPX 60-day returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp slowdown in housing starts, indicating a weakening construction sector, will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, especially if accompanied by slowing industrial production.
failure_condition: HOUST declines >10% Y/Y and INDPRO is slowing, but SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the consumer price index, indicating high inflation, will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, especially if accompanied by rising interest rates.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises >3% Y/Y and FEDFUNDS are rising, but SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.
